reviews.text:
We have had such tremendous results with Selah pools.  Barton has been extremely helpful with our pool maintenance program.
He has been able to navigate us through difficult decisions on when to repair and when to replace equipment and make modifications.
These guy’s are totally trustworthy in dealing with all aspects of your pool! Nice to know there are Christian based companies out there who highly regard faith virtues and integrity.
These guy’s are top notch!
Kevin Kell
reviews.author: Kevin Kell

reviews.text: This was our 2nd pool installation with the first from another company that it didn't go well. The purchasing experience with Caleb and the build/project management with John from Selah was nothing short of amazing. No surprises, complete transparency and an excellent resulting product is what we received and couldn't be more thankful. Highly, highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Al Liszewski

reviews.text: I was very satisfied with the remodeling of my pool, deck and patio, from initial contact with Selah through to its completion.  Caleb, the sales associate/designer,  took the time to answer our questions about the pool components.  John, the project manager, kept us closely posted personally, and via email, as the work progressed. I would certainly recommend them to others.
reviews.author: William “Bill” Gross

reviews.text: Excellent experience from start to finish. Caleb made a real effort to understand our needs and translate them into a design that fit exactly what we were looking for. Very attentive, thoughtful, and easy to communicate with. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Mieke and Sebastian Danobeitia

reviews.text: James, Caleb, and John from Selah Pools did an outstanding job on designing and building our back patio on our new home. We requested bids from several companies and I saw a pergola at another home in our neighborhood that looked very nice. I knocked on the front door and the occupant gave me the name and number for Selah Pools so I called and left a message and they responded right away. James came over to see what I wanted and the submitted a bid and some suggestions that we eventually went with. They weren’t the low bid nor the high one but their product looked better than any of the others we received.  John  was outstanding throughout the entire process and made sure everything was done according to plan. We couldn’t be happier with our new backyard patio that looks like it came built with the house.  I highly recommend Selah Pools.
reviews.author: Ken Lee

reviews.text: I had an amazing experience with Selah Pools! From start to finish, the team was professional and attentive. John, our project supervisor, was always on top of things, ensuring everything went smoothly. Caleb, our designer, did a fantastic job bringing our vision to life. Their attention to detail and commitment to customer service were outstanding. The pool looks absolutely stunning, and we couldn't be happier. Highly recommend Selah Pools for anyone looking to create their dream pool!
reviews.author: Michelle McCraney

reviews.text: Wow, we can't say enough good things about Selah Pools! They turned our backyard into a total paradise, and the whole experience was stress free. We obtained several quotes and designs from other pool companies before deciding on Selah. From day one, they were super responsive and really listened to exactly what we wanted and I am very particular. The construction process was smooth, and the pool turned out absolutely beautiful. The entire team was friendly, and they made sure we were in the loop the whole time. The minor issues we had, they handled promptly. Thank you to the entire team we worked with; Caleb, James, John, and Mark!! You all were amazing and met my very high expectations.
reviews.author: Ashley Harden

reviews.text: We had a great pool design experience with Caleb. He is very knowledgeable and truly enjoys his work in helping customers achieve their dream pool.
reviews.author: John Hendrix

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic with strong evidence of genuine customer experiences. The company has high ratings across multiple platforms with specific, detailed reviews mentioning staff by name and project specifics. No concerning complaint patterns detected.
fake_signals: Strategic sample shows only 5-star reviews, but full dataset has 154 reviews
Some reviews mention Christian/faith virtues which could be a subtle in-group signal

positive_evidence: Barton navigated difficult decisions on repair vs. replace

authentic_signals: Reviews mention specific employee names (Caleb, John, Barton, James)
Detailed project descriptions (remodeling, new installation, maintenance)
Mentions of comparing multiple bids and previous bad experiences
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistently high across all platforms (Google 4.8, Yelp 4.0, Angi 4.4, Houzz 5.0). The BBB A+ rating indicates good complaint handling. Minor variations are normal for different customer bases and review volumes.
